messages.content: 哪一家網上書店有售《殺死一隻知更鳥》？

function.name: add_product_to_cart
function.description: This function allows users to add a product to their cart. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

quantity.description: The number of this product to add to the cart

cart_id.description: The ID of the cart, if no ID is given a new cart is created

message.content:
以下是幾家常見的網上書店，您可以在這些平台上搜尋並購買《殺死一隻知更鳥》：

| 平台 | 特色 | 連結 |
|------|------|------|
| **博客來 (Books.com.tw)** | 台灣最大的線上書店，提供多種語言版本、快速配送。 | https://www.books.com.tw |
| **金石堂 (JinShuTao)** | 以實體書店起家，線上平台也很成熟，常有折扣。 | https://www.jinshutao.com |
| **誠品 (Eslite)** | 以精品書店聞名，線上平台提供精選書籍與禮盒。 | https://www.eslite.com |
| **Amazon (Amazon.com.tw)** | 全球最大的電商平台，提供多種版本與配件。 | https://www.amazon.com.tw |
| **讀書人 (Readmoo)** | 主要是電子書平台，但也有紙本書籍銷售。 | https://www.readmoo.com |
| **好讀 (Goodreads)** | 雖然不是銷售平台，但可查看書評與購買連結。 | https://www.goodreads.com |

如果您已經決定購買，請告訴我您想在哪個平台下單，我可以協助您將書加入購物車。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "哪一家網上書店有售《殺死一隻知更鳥》？" They want to know which online bookstore sells "To Kill a Mockingbird" (殺死一隻知更鳥). We need to respond in Chinese. We can provide a list of major online bookstores in Taiwan or China that sell the book. We can mention Amazon, Books.com.tw, 博客來, 金石堂, 誠品, etc. Provide suggestions. Also ask if they want to purchase. We can ask if they want to add to cart. But we should not call the function unless they explicitly want to add. So we just answer.
